map.留针时间（按病症）推荐 使用指南: Needle Retention Time (by Condition) Recommendation User Guide
map.按病症类型与体质建议留针时长范围，并提示禁忌与注意事项，供针灸操作参考（仅供参考: Recommend a needle retention range by condition type and constitution, with contraindications and precautions, for reference during acupuncture (for reference only, not a medical prescription; follow medical advice).
map.寒证、虚证留针偏长。: For cold and deficiency patterns the needle is retained longer.
map.急性痛证留针并行针。: For acute pain conditions retain the needle and use parallel needling.
map.老弱、儿童留针偏短。: For the elderly, weak and children the retention is shorter.
map.：虚寒性关节痛，建议留针 25–30 分钟、每 10 分钟行针；风热咽痛建议浅刺: For cold-damp joint pain, retain the needle 25-30 minutes and manipulate every 10 minutes; for wind-heat sore throat use shallow needling retained 10-15 minutes, shortened by another third for the elderly and children; and warn about contraindications such as fainting and stuck needles.
map.推拿手法频率(每分钟次数)标准器: Massage Technique Frequency (Per Minute) Standard Tool
map.推拿介质(油/膏)选择依据器: Massage Medium (Oil / Balm) Selection Basis Tool
map.留针期间要注意什么？: What should I watch for during retention?
map.观察有无晕针（心慌、汗出）、滞针；起针按压防出血；本工具结果仅供参考，不能替代医: Watch for fainting reactions (palpitations, sweating) and stuck needles; press the point on removal to prevent bleeding. The results here are for reference only and do not replace a physician's diagnosis and prescription; follow medical advice when performing.
map.留针时长须结合辨证，个体差异大，不能替代医师处方。: Needle retention has to be combined with pattern differentiation; individual differences are large and it cannot replace a physician's prescription.
